title: The Whispering Woods Rescue
markdown:
Deep in the Whispering Woods lived Clank, a brass robot gardener whose joints sang when he was happy; Orla, a foxglove dryad with leafy hair; and Percy, a dormouse inventor whose gadgets bounced before they even switched on. Their days were sunshine, sprockets, and Percy’s bounciest ideas.

Then the Royal Greenhouse went bonkers. Giant thorny vines burst from the ground, hissing. Royal gardeners yelped like startled teacups. Clank clanked with distress. Orla’s leafy hair drooped. Percy’s nose twitched. “These vines are wiggling on their own!”

That night they hid and watched. The vines twisted, coiled, and—poof—formed spiky letters.

“It’s a code!” Percy squeaked. “It says WARNING.”

“WARNING?” Orla whispered.

Clank whirred. “It says… STORM.”

“And another word,” Percy exclaimed. “SEEDLING LOST.”

A lost seedling and a storm. Percy’s gadget-clock showed the wind would pick up in two hours. The roof of the greenhouse could go. A lost seedling was precious.

Orla touched a thorny vine. “You’re trying to tell us something, aren’t you?” A green glow pulsed as she coaxed them. They rearranged, shimmering. Percy aimed his gadget. “Clearer now. SEEDLING NEAR WATER PUMP.”

“The old water pump,” Clank whirred. “That’s where the rare Moonpetal was planted.”

They zoomed to the dusty pump. There sat a tiny drooping seedling. Raindrops began to fall.

Quick as a wink, Percy conjured a shimmering bubble. Clank lifted the fragile seedling. Orla guided the whispering vines into a leafy shelter around the bubble. The Moonpetal breathed easy. Outside, the storm howled. Inside, three friends hummed—Clank in clanks, Orla in a sweet leafy tune, Percy with a wink and a giggle that bounced like his best invention.
characters: Clank (a brass robot gardener), Orla (a foxglove dryad), Percy (a dormouse inventor)
